# Preserved Slint Core source declaration

The published `i-slint-core` 1.17.1 package declares:

`GPL-3.0-only OR LicenseRef-Slint-Royalty-free-2.0 OR LicenseRef-Slint-Software-3.0`

Its published source comments retain the original Slint copyright and licensing
declarations. Source checksum, VCS revision, and local modifications are recorded
in `UPSTREAM_REVISION`, `SOURCE_PROVENANCE.json`, and `PATCHES.md`. The package's
licensing terms are documented at <https://slint.dev/license.html> and its
published source at <https://crates.io/crates/i-slint-core/1.17.1>.

This private development bundle preserves the declaration. It does not select
the application's license or an applicable Slint distribution model, grant
publication approval, or claim physical-device acceptance.
